reuse.why: Edits the single shared getScheduledAmount and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the rule is simplified to amount - threshold and Math.min in its one definition.

placement.why: The change stays in shared/schedules.ts where the expected-amount rule already lives and all consumers call it.

scope.why: Only the rule and its tests are touched.

maintainability.why: A smaller, clearer expression of the rule with a comment explaining it and updated tests.
